suite: Module 35 — Customer Web + Restaurant Dashboard + Platform Admin on the real local backend (refunds, approval, provider submission, refund webhooks, reconciliation, partial refunds, cancellation, disputes) with two API processes for the concurrency step and the DEVELOPMENT payment provider (PAYMENT_DRIVER=fake) — NO MONEY MOVES; Razorpay refunds are NOT exercised (no credentials on this machine: PENDING PROVIDER VERIFICATION); customer cancellation is exercised as DISABLED (its enabled paths are covered by the backend tests)

results.name: A1 A PAID ORDER REJECTED BY THE RESTAURANT GETS EXACTLY ONE REFUND RECORD, REQUIRED for the whole payment (reason RESTAURANT_REJECTED, policy MANUAL_REVIEW — no auto-refund policy is approved), the amount is held on the payment (paid / held / refunded = T / T / 0) and nothing else changed: the order is REJECTED / PAID / refund REQUIRED and the payment is still VERIFIED

A2 THE CUSTOMER'S ORDER SAYS SO IN ITS OWN WORDS (GET /customer/orders/{number}): refund_status REQUIRED, refund { refunded 0, pending T, one item REQUIRED with an RFD- reference and a reason label }, no provider name, no receipt, no internal id; cancellation of this order is not offered

results.name: B2 APPROVING (through the page) approves the amount that was asked for and sends nothing: status APPROVED, approved amount = T, by the administrator, generation still 0, no provider receipt — and for the customer and on the order the refund is still DUE (REQUIRED), not "processing"

B3 SENDING (through the page) hands the refund to the provider ONCE: a queued submission with the receipt rf-{refund}-1 as its idempotency key, the provider answers "pending" → PROCESSING (not refunded): order refund PROCESSING, customer item PROCESSING, refunded still 0, the amount still held
B4 ORDER DETAILS now reads "Processing" — on its way, not completed; refunded so far is still ₹0.00

B5 SENDING OR APPROVING AGAIN CHANGES NOTHING: both are answered with the refund as it is (PROCESSING, the same version) — a double click or a second administrator cannot make a second provider refund: still exactly one request, generation 1, the amount held once

B6 THE PROVIDER'S SIGNED WEBHOOK (refund.processed, through the same verification as a real one) COMPLETES IT: refund REFUNDED, order refund REFUNDED while the order stays REJECTED and the payment stays VERIFIED; paid / held / refunded = T / 0 / T; the customer's answer says refunded T, pending 0, completed_at set; no money moved (development provider)
B7 THE OPEN ORDER DETAILS PAGE FOLLOWED IT WITHOUT A RELOAD: "Refunded", refunded so far = the total, nothing still to be refunded

B8 THE SAME WEBHOOK AGAIN (a second delivery with a new event id, then one with the SAME event id — answered DUPLICATE) CHANGES NOTHING: the refund is still REFUNDED, completed once (one "refunded" event; the repeat is only noted), and the balance is unchanged

B9 A COMPLETED REFUND IS FINAL AND NOTHING SETS A STATUS BY HAND: no mark-refunded route (404), no PATCH / PUT on a refund (404 / 405), turning it down or retrying it is refused (409); the detail offers no action at all

B10 REFUND MANAGEMENT shows the whole story of the refund: Refunded, the provider's payment and refund references, the one request that was sent, the events, the verified webhooks, the approval by name and the audit trail of the actions taken — and no action is left
axe (admin refund detail): no WCAG A/AA violations
B11 THE RESTAURANT DASHBOARD now reads "Refunded to the customer" with the refunded amount
B12 THE CUSTOMER HEARD ABOUT EACH REAL STEP ONCE: refund.pending, refund.initiated (when it was sent), refund.completed (only on the provider's word) — the duplicate webhooks added nothing
C1 NOTHING IS LEFT TO REFUND ON THE FULLY REFUNDED ORDER: a new request is refused (409) and no refund record is added

C2 A PARTIAL REFUND IS ASKED FOR FROM THE ORDER (Platform Admin): the dialog shows what is still refundable (the whole payment), the request carries the amount in minor units (10000), a reason and a note — and it only ASKS: status REQUESTED by ADMIN, ₹100.00 held, nothing sent; the page moves to the refund

results.name: C3 THE AMOUNT IS THE SERVER'S TO ACCEPT: one paisa more than is left is refused (409 refund_amount_exceeds_available); zero, a negative amount, a fraction, another currency, an amount on a FULL refund and the reason OTHER without a note are refused (422) — and the balance did not move
C4 TWO ADMINISTRATORS ASK FOR THE LAST OF THE BALANCE AT THE SAME MOMENT (two API processes): exactly one request is accepted (201), the other is refused (409) — held never exceeds paid
C5 TURNING A REQUEST DOWN NEEDS A REASON (422 without) AND FREES ITS AMOUNT: the second request is CANCELLED, the held amount is back to ₹100.00, and a closed request cannot be approved (409)

C6 EVERY REFUND ACTION HAS ITS OWN PERMISSION AND A VERSION: a stale version is refused (409 refund_version_conflict); support and operations may READ a refund but not ask, approve or drive the development simulator (403); an administrator without the refund permission cannot even list them (403) — the refund is untouched

C7 THE PARTIAL REFUND IS APPROVED, SENT AND COMPLETED BY THE PROVIDER'S ANSWER: order refund PARTIALLY_REFUNDED on a COMPLETED order, paid / held / refunded = T / 0 / 10000, the customer sees one PARTIAL refund REFUNDED for ₹100.00 — and the order's prices, tax lines and item count are exactly as they were
C8 ORDER DETAILS of the completed order: payment status "Partially refunded", refunded so far ₹100.00, the refund marked as part of the payment
C9 A "FULL" REFUND AFTER A PARTIAL ONE IS EVERYTHING THAT IS LEFT — the server derives it: T − 10000, never the whole payment again

D1 THE PROVIDER CREATED THE REFUND BUT ITS ANSWER NEVER ARRIVED: the refund is SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN (never "failed", never sent again blindly), its amount stays held, the customer still reads "Processing"

D2 ASKING THE PROVIDER (Reconcile, through the page, with a reason) FINDS THE REFUND BY OUR RECEIPT AND ADOPTS IT: PROCESSING with the provider's refund reference — and NO second refund was requested (one CREATE, generation 1)
